# LAYER 2 - slow held notes that overlap with LAYER 1
# Each chord = 8 beats: one long note (5), a pause (1), a short note (1.5), a rest (0.5)

MELODY_VOL = 0.14   # quieter than the chords so it sits behind them

melody = [
    [70, 67],   # over Ebmaj7: Bb4, G4
    [67, 63],   # over Cm7:    G4, Eb4
    [72, 67],   # over Abmaj7: C5, G4
    [65, 62],   # over Bb(add9): F4, D4
]

for cycle in range(2):
    for m in range(len(melody)):
        # fade out on the very last phrase
        if cycle == 1 and m == 3:
                playNote(melody[m][0], beats = 5)
                rest(beats = 1)
                playNote(melody[m][1], beats = 1.5)
                rest(beats = 0.5)
        else
                playNote(melody[m][0], beats = 5)
                rest(beats = 1)
                playNote(melody[m][1], beats = 1.5)
                rest(beats = 0.5)

# LAYER 3 - soft piano
# Follows the same chord loop as Layer 1: Ebmaj7 -> Cm7 -> Abmaj7 -> Bb(add9)
# Each chord = 8 beats: low root (3.5) + rest (0.5) + high note (3) + rest (1)

BASS_VOL = 0.20     # deep root notes (try 0.12 - 0.25)
HIGH_VOL = 0.15     # quiet high notes, like soft chimes

bass_notes = [39, 36, 32, 34]   # Eb2, C2, Ab1, Bb1 (the root of each chord)
high_notes = [74, 75, 79, 77]   # D5, Eb5, G5, F5 (a chord tone from each chord)

rest(beats = 16)    # piano enters after the guitars have established the mood
                    # (beat 16 is where the Abmaj7 chord begins in Layer 1)

for step in range(6):                       # 6 chords x 8 beats = 48 beats
    c = (step + 2) % 4                      # start on the 3rd chord to stay in sync

    if step == 5:
        with gain([BASS_VOL, 0.20], beats = 8):
            playNote(bass_notes[c], beats = 3.5)
            rest(beats = 0.5)
            playNote(high_notes[c], beats = 3)
            rest(beats = 1)
    else:
        with gain(BASS_VOL, 0.20):
            playNote(bass_notes[c], beats = 3.5)
        rest(beats = 0.5)                   # small gap so the bass note rings out
        with gain(HIGH_VOL):
            playNote(high_notes[c], beats = 3)
        rest(beats = 1)

# Each chord = 8 beats: (note, length) pairs, with a 0.5 rest after every note

rest(beats = 64)

melody = [
    [(72, 3), (75, 2.5), (67, 1)],    # over Abmaj7: C5, Eb5, G4
    [(75, 3), (72, 2.5), (68, 1)],    # over Fm7:    Eb5, C5, Ab4

    [(74, 3), (70, 2.5), (68, 1)],    # over Bb7:    D5, Bb4, Ab4 (tension)
    [(70, 5), (67, 2)],               # over Ebmaj7: Bb4, G4 (resolves)
]

vols = [0.12, 0.15, 0.18, 0.18, 0.14, 0]

for i in range(5):
    with gain([vols[i], vols[i + 1]], beats = 8):
        for note, length in melody[i]:
            playNote(note, beats = length)
            rest(beats = 0.5)         # lets each note ring out before the next
